remarks: Rare four-unit multi-family opportunity in Greenwich's Chickahominy neighborhood.   11 Columbus Ave offers 8 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms total across four separate units on a private lot, close to downtown Greenwich Avenue, Metro-North rail, and I-95/Merritt Parkway access.  Offering approximately 5,250 square feet, with separate utilities/meters and off street parking. Each unit features 2 beds, 1 bath and a living room.  Ideal for an owner-occupant looking to offset their mortgage with rental income, or an investor seeking a four-unit income asset in a strong rental market.  Minutes from Greenwich's shops, restaurants, schools, and parks, with easy access to NYC via Metro-North.   Multi-family inventory of this scale is limited in Greenwich - schedule your showing today.
